plan: A divine warrior who stuns his target and falls from the sky with his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His W (Shield Vault). He leaps onto you and stuns you, then follows up: keep your distance in the early game.
contrer: Don't fight him early: he is very strong early.
His shield (E) blocks attacks from the front: attack him from behind.
When a red zone appears on the ground, move away: he is about to land there.
forces: Very strong in the early game.
His R engages from very far.
faiblesses: His R is easy to see coming.

sorts.P: After a few spells or attacks, his next spell is empowered.
sorts.E: Shield that blocks attacks from the front.
sorts.R: Leaps and lands like a meteor.

momentFort: Very strong in the early game.
